name: prop-car
about: Nest Egg Run's car (third version: the first one's buttressed tail read as a famous Italian coupe, the second as a famous British compact SUV): a small armoured runabout in the war rig's own world, gunmetal bolted plates, a short cab with slit windows, a covered crate strapped in its bed, big off-road wheels with cyan hubs, a magenta tail bar. Tripo v3.1 at its standard (low-credit) settings from concept traffic-car-c-sd-1, one attempt; mirrored to exact symmetry.
